headline: Weathered Expanse Clashes Rage As Coastal Fronts Trade Outposts
war_summary: Frontline dispatches indicate ferocious contest continuing in the Weathered Expanse, where seven strategic base transfers were logged over the past two hours amid relentless fighting around Necropolis and Wightwalk. Westward, Farranac Coast has surged back to life with three rapid exchanges at Mara and Scythe, while island garrisons across Fishermans Row and Godcrofts sustained ongoing turnover. In contrast, the earlier naval clashes in Lykos Isle and Oarbreaker have subsided into relative quiet, with no territorial transfers recorded in the latest two-hour interval. Mainland attrition remains fierce; Dead Lands, Linn of Mercy, and Loch Mor maintain heavy casualty tolls without further line shifts, even as an abrupt influx of enlistments and sharp casualty spikes in Stonecradle suggest mounting pressure along the northwestern approaches. Stlican Shelf also registered fresh activity near Thornhold, keeping the northeastern corridor highly unstable.
